title: Bills TE Dalton Kincaid passed on knee surgery, feels "best I’ve felt in my career"

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Bills TE Dalton Kincaid passed on knee surgery, feels "best I’ve felt in my career"
sources.description: Bills tight end Dalton Kincaid has dealt with a PCL injury to his left knee for the last two seasons, but he did not have surgery to address the tear this offseason.
